title: Custom Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** SAP ABAP Development for HANA  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves designing and developing tailored software solutions that integrate seamlessly across various systems and applications. The role requires continuous collaboration with different teams to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient components. Utilizing modern development frameworks and agile methodologies, the engineer focuses on enhancing existing functionalities and creating new features that align with evolving business requirements. This position demands adaptability and a proactive approach to problem\-solving within a dynamic work environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the implementation of best practices to improve software quality and delivery timelines.
* Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing.
* Coordinate cross\-functional efforts to align project goals with organizational objectives.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP ABAP Development for HANA.
* Experience in developing and optimizing custom code for SAP HANA environments.
* Strong understanding of database concepts and performance tuning within SAP systems.
* Familiarity with agile software development methodologies and continuous integration practices.
* Ability to analyze complex business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Skilled in debugging, testing, and maintaining high\-quality software components.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in SAP ABAP Development for HANA.


\- This position is based at our KDC1A \- SEZ location.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: DATA MANAGEMENT EXECUTIVE / ERP DEVELOPER EXECUTIVE
description:
Job description:

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented ERP Executive / ERP Developer to manage, maintain, and develop our ERP system while ensuring strong MIS reporting and data management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with process flow management, flowcharts, and various management systems such as FMS, IMS, and MIS.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and maintain the organization's ERP system, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning.
* Develop, customize, and enhance ERP modules as per business requirements.
* Design, prepare, and maintain process flowcharts for different business operations.
* Handle process flow management to streamline operational processes across departments.
* Collect, organize, and maintain accurate data across departments and systems.
* Ensure data integrity, cleanliness, and consistency in the ERP system and related databases.
* Prepare, update, and maintain MIS reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of all MIS reports to the management team.
* Coordinate with different departments to gather data and validate records in the ERP system.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive company data.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in ERP system management and/or ERP development.
* Strong knowledge of data management practices and MIS reporting.
* Proficiency in creating process flowcharts (Google Sheets/docs, flowchart tools or similar.
* Working knowledge of FMS, IMS, and MIS systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Dashboards, etc.)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and ensure timely report submission.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund
